name: warpos
description: WarpOS — autonomous AI operating system for software engineering. Registry-driven hooks, transactional updates, honest release gates, generic promotion.
notes: Sprint Workflow v0.1 — adds /sprint:plan, /sprint:design, /sprint:execute, /sprint:release as a product-workflow layer above existing modes. Plan Contract artifact bridges brief founder intent to durable, evidence-labeled, approval-aware, crash-recoverable sprint state. 10 new schemas under schemas/sprint/. 19 new tracker paths in framework/paths.registry.json (sprint*/) — all owner:runtime|framework, no live tracker state seeded in the framework repo. Tickets sit below requirements/stories/COPY/INPUTS/TRACE/AC. Ralph loop integration for governed plan/act/test/review/record/checkpoint per ticket with crash-safe progress. External Service Dependency artifact for signup/billing/credentials/OAuth/DNS/compliance lifecycle. Sprint routing policy at paths.sprintRouting declares model classes per phase; honors paths.providerFallbackPolicy. Existing modes, hooks, paths, agents, requirements, and capsule layout are unchanged. See _docs/sprint/FINAL_REPORT.md.
